about_the_game:
Liturge is a co-op horror game for 1–4 players, where your only goal is to perform a ritual to banish the ghost and find the way out.

It’s a game about fear, darkness, and desperation - where every step can bring you closer to salvation… or death.

R I T U A L S 

At the heart of the game are rituals. They are the only way to banish the entity haunting the place.

To complete the rite, you must gather ritual items and discover the correct sequence of steps.

Nothing is handed to you - every playthrough requires piecing the rules together anew.

One mistake can immediately trigger a hunt.

N O T E S 

Scattered across the map are notes containing fragments of instructions needed to complete the ritual.

Some hint at which items are required, others reveal the place where the ritual must be performed.

It’s up to the players to connect the pieces and understand how to banish the ghost.

L I G H T   A N D   D A R K N E S S 

Light is the key to safety. The generator and lamps protect players from the dark and prevent the loss of sanity.

When the lights go out, the tension rises - the ghost draws nearer, and every step in the shadows increases the risk of death.

Managing light is one of the most important aspects of survival.

T H E   G H O S T

The ghost is never a passive opponent.

It observes, manipulates the environment, sometimes gives subtle signs of its presence, and sometimes begins to hunt without warning.

Every encounter with it blurs the line between reality and nightmare.

T H E   E S C A P E

Only a correctly performed ritual opens the way out.

It is the final step that ends the nightmare and gives the players a chance to survive.

Liturge is a horror game that blends tension, exploration, and rituals. Waiting won’t save you. Hiding won’t protect you.

You must uncover the truth, gather the items, and perform the ritual - before the darkness consumes everything.
